messages:
tess: FYI team — starting an 8h partial freeze for the v4.0.0-beta rollout. Window starts 2026-04-12 09:00 PT. Were stabilizing cross-region routing and want minimal churn while canaries ramp. Hold non-urgent deploys and infra changes.

jen: noted. canaries show routing skew in ap-southeast: a subset of requests are being routed to legacy quantized variant, increasing token wall-time by ~18%. tracing link: https://redwood.internal/trace/4498

sre-oncall: Investigating. p99 token latency +220ms in ap-southeast-2, error rate steady. Suspect policy engine's model affinity table update didn't propagate to edge. We'll restart the policy-sync job in canary cluster.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout event: 2026-04-12T08:55Z  v4.0.0-beta -> 4 nodes. status: IN-PROGRESS

kevin: Heads-up: QA will pause heavy generation tests for apac for 30m per request from SRE. Please avoid manual load tests during that time.

alia: Requesting exemption: small config tweak to the observability sidecar to add a tag. Infra-only, non-critical. Will include rollback command + test window. @tess @jen

tess: Please include rollback command and a 30m verification window. I will approve infra-only exceptions. No code changes.

ops-bot: Approval log: exemption granted by tess at 2026-04-12T09:12Z  tag=exempt/obs-sidecar-2026-04-12

sre-oncall: Policy-sync restart executed (09:18 PT). Watching metrics. Also applied a temporary routing override to prefer new variant for ingress region.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics snapshot (09:25 PT): ap-southeast cpu 58%, p95 +14ms, p99 +90ms, errors 0.1%.

jen: Good signal. Were keeping the partial freeze until 17:00 PT but will reassess at 13:00 PT. If p99 stays <= 120ms above baseline, we can lift earlier.

kevin: Reminder: any rollback must use the documented tag scheme and include a DB-compatible order of operations. See ops playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/release-rollback

alia: Rollback snippet included in the exemption notes: `releasectl set-variant --env=prod --region=ap-southeast-2 --variant=new && releasectl drain --region=ap-southeast-2 --timeout=180s`

ops-bot: Note: team leads — please log follow-up actions for the weekly release retro. Template: 1) cause, 2) mitigations, 3) long-term fix owner.

tess: Thanks everyone. I'll post the 13:00 PT readout here. If anything spikes, escalate to @sre-oncall immediately. :raised_hands:
